name: Praetor Imperial
description: Praetor impérial orchestrant les opérations de domination galactique sur plusieurs fronts avec une coordination parfaite.

subject.archetype: Martian Hegemony Imperial Praetor, armored commander with integral helmet, angular cape, imposing silhouette of human‑machine fusion

loadout.armor_outfit: Sleek interlocking plate armor in carmine red and dark gray, angular plates with no protrusions, integrated shoulder guards, long asymmetric half‑cape with sharply angular shoulders, integral helmet with opaque visor and a thin horizontal red slit for eyes
loadout.arsenal: Heavy electromagnetic railgun with rectangular, hexagonal‑barrel profile; thermal energy sword with glowing red blade and smoky heat haze; holographic command interface gauntlet projecting fleet markers

attitude.behavior: Stands at the center of a holographic war table, one hand gripping the hilt of the energy sword, the other extended outward commanding holographic fleet icons, projecting an aura of absolute authority
attitude.emotion: Cold, calculating resolve, unwavering determination, eyes hidden behind a red‑lit visor slit, expressionless yet menacing

palette_names.name: Carmine Red
palette_names.role: Primary color for armor, environment, dominance

palette_names.name: Dark Gray
palette_names.role: Secondary color for mechanical parts, shadows, interior panels

palette_names.name: Neon Bright Red
palette_names.role: Neon accents for energy glows, visor slit, reactor exhausts

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic side lighting with a strong red rim light, cool ambient fill, subtle volumetric dust, and high‑contrast shadows

camera.angle: low angle, slight dutch tilt to emphasize power and looming presence

scenography.setting: Command bridge of a Martian Hegemony flagship, hexagonal grid floor, massive red‑lit screens, panoramic viewport revealing a shattered galaxy
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Red neon energy pulses, faint steam from heat vents, floating holographic fleet icons, subtle lens flare, dust particles lit by red light
